articles.summary: In semiconductor fabrication, RF power plays a crucial role in plasma generation used for etching and deposition to build the complex, layered structures of modern integrated circuits (ICs). Delivering the correct power into each process step must be tightly controlled and repeatable, and critical device structure tolerances are shrinking with each process node generation.
articles.title: Model-Based Frequency Tuning Revolutionizes RF Power Delivery

articles.summary: Advanced Energy provides a wide range of modifiable PSUs, supporting industries like medical and defense. Their modifications range from simple tweaks to complex redesigns, enabling rapid adaptation to customer needs while maintaining compliance and accelerating time to market.
articles.title: How Advanced Energy’s Modified Standards Offer a Competitive Advantage for Power Supply Designs
